# PaperGrade AI (PaperGradeAI)

> Handwritten subjective answer sheet evaluation and academic examination workflow platform for coaching institutes and schools.

Canonical Website: https://www.papergradeai.in
Support Email: support@papergradeai.in

## Overview

PaperGrade AI (also referred to as PaperGradeAI) helps coaching institutes keep subjective tests on physical handwritten paper while eliminating manual paper-checking bottlenecks. Teachers lock step-marking rubrics before evaluation, AI maps awarded marks directly onto scanned student script regions, and faculty retain final authority over review and publication.

## Core Capabilities

- **Handwritten Subjective Evaluation**: Grades multi-page handwritten answers across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, and board or competitive subjective exams, including derivations, equations, and labeled diagrams.
- **Teacher-Locked Rubrics**: Faculty define step weights, model answers, accepted alternatives, and optional best-of-N question selection rules prior to grading.
- **Visual Bounding-Box Citations**: Every mark awarded or deducted links directly to a highlighted bounding box on the student's scanned PDF page alongside criterion rationale.
- **Timed Student Submission Windows**: Students capture paper pages or upload PDFs from mobile devices during instructor-controlled live submission windows with grace-period support.
- **Audited Revaluation Workflow**: After publication, students can contest specific questions and teachers resolve appeals with cropped handwriting inspection and audit trails.
- **Multi-Branch Institute & Batch Isolation**: Role-based access for Institute Directors, Branch Managers, and Students with CSV roster imports, ranked standings exports, and optional student Google Drive backup.
